title: 速效救心丸的分类属性、注册包装规格与已发表给药时长：家庭一次性大量购药的证据与合规边界

claims.claim: 速效救心丸由川芎（四甲基吡嗪）与冰片组成，批准文号为 Z12020025。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: SJP is composed of tetramethylpyrazine and borneol approval number Z12020025 of the China State Food and Drug Administration
claims.applicability: 开放获取研究方案全文记载的批准文号，用于核对本品注册登记信息
claims.uncertainty: 批准文号经同行评议全文记载，但 NMPA 官方登记信息未在本轮直接核验

claims.claim: 速效救心丸每丸重 40 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.applicability: 规格表述，与说明书索引件一致
claims.uncertainty: 说明书索引件与全文一致记载 40 mg，官方现行原文未经直接核验

claims.claim: 已发表随机对照试验中速效救心丸的试验剂量为每次 5 丸、每日 3 次。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: they will have to take 5 pills of the study medication three times daily
claims.applicability: 试验剂量落在说明书转载口径的 4～6 丸范围内
claims.uncertainty: 试验剂量由方案规定，不等于说明书法定剂量

claims.claim: 稳定型心绞痛试验的干预时长为 24 周（即 6 个月）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks
claims.applicability: 已发表证据支持的最长连续给药时长来源之一
claims.uncertainty: 为方案规定时长，不是说明书明示疗程

claims.claim: 稳定型心绞痛试验计划纳入 324 例慢性稳定型心绞痛（气滞血瘀证）患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
claims.supportQuote: The trial will enroll 324 participants with chronic stable angina (Qi Stagnation and Blood Stasis syndrome).
claims.applicability: 纳入人群证型落在说明书气滞血瘀型冠心病心绞痛适应症内
claims.uncertainty: 为计划入组数，方案发表时已招募 293 例

claims.claim: 慢性冠脉综合征试验的给药为舌下含服每次 5 粒、每日 3 次（共 15 粒/日），连续 4 周。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: orally administer the study medication sublingually after meals, three times a day, taking 5 capsules each time (total of 15 capsules per day), continuously for 4 weeks
claims.applicability: 已发表证据支持的最短连续给药时长（4 周）来源
claims.uncertainty: 4 周为短程干预，不能代表更长疗程的效果

claims.claim: 用药 4 周后速效救心丸组疗效显著优于安慰剂（OR = 2.43，95% CI 1.32～4.47，P = 0.004）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: the SJPs group showed a significant improvement in the efficacy rate after 4 weeks (OR = 2.43, 95% CI = 1.32 to 4.47, P = 0.004)
claims.applicability: 主要终点效应量，用于衡量 4 周短程疗效
claims.uncertainty: 样本量小、疗程短，未报告心血管事件终点

claims.claim: 速效救心丸组主要终点有效率为 60.9%，安慰剂组为 39.1%。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: 60.9% of patients treated with SJPs achieved a 20-point or greater improvement in SAQ-SS, while only 39.1%
claims.applicability: 主要终点的组间率差
claims.uncertainty: 有效定义为西雅图心绞痛量表总分改善 ≥ 20 分，为症状学终点

claims.claim: 速效救心丸组西雅图心绞痛量表总分较安慰剂多改善 5.68 分（95% CI 2.37～8.99）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: the SJPs intervention resulted in an improvement of 5.68 (95% CI = 2.37 to 8.99, P < 0.001, SJPs vs. placebo: 15.46 vs. 9.78 ) for the summary score in SAQ (SAQ-SS)
claims.applicability: 主要终点连续变量的组间差
claims.uncertainty: 症状学量表终点，不延伸至死亡率或心血管事件

claims.claim: 慢性冠脉综合征试验纳入 174 例（改良意向治疗分析），来自中国 8 个临床中心。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: A total of 174 CCS participants from eight clinical study centers in China were included in the modified intention-to-treat analyses.
claims.applicability: 样本量与多中心设计说明该证据的外推边界
claims.uncertainty: 样本量有限，效力不足以检验部分次要终点

claims.claim: 速效救心丸于 1982 年获中国药品监督管理部门批准上市。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: which was approved by China Food and Drug Administration (CFDA) in 1982
claims.applicability: 上市时间的同行评议记载
claims.uncertainty: 记载于文献而非注册登记原文

claims.claim: 慢性冠脉综合征试验期内无参与者报告不良反应。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: No participants reported experiencing adverse effects.
claims.applicability: 4 周短程、特定人群内的安全性观察
claims.uncertainty: 样本量小、疗程短，不足以据此估计发生率

claims.claim: 一项 Meta 分析纳入 41 项试验、6276 例冠心病患者。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The 41 studies consisted of 6276 patients with coronary heart disease.
claims.applicability: 本品随机对照证据的总量估计
claims.uncertainty: 纳入试验均为中国研究，多数方法学质量低

claims.claim: Meta 分析报告速效救心丸改善心电图结果（RR 1.32，95% CI 1.26～1.38，P < 0.001）。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: improved electrocardiogram (ECG) results when compared with other therapies (RR 1.32, 95% CI 1.26 to 1.38, and P < 0.001)
claims.applicability: 心电图改善为替代终点，不直接等同于临床事件获益
claims.uncertainty: 异质性高（I² = 62.3%），纳入试验多缺乏双盲

claims.claim: Meta 分析纳入的多数试验因缺乏双盲设计获低 Jadad 评分，方法学质量差。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: Most of the clinical studies included in our meta-analysis were of poor quality based on their Jadad scores.
claims.applicability: 偏倚风险评价依据，用于 GRADE 降级
claims.uncertainty: 作者自评的低质量，本报告未逐篇复评

claims.claim: Meta 分析记载的最常见不良反应为轻度头痛、头晕与面部潮红。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill on Coronary Heart Disease: A Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
claims.supportQuote: The most common symptoms were mild headache, dizziness, and facial flushing.
claims.applicability: 已有记载的不良反应，不用于估计发生率
claims.uncertainty: 无分母、无标准化因果关系评定，发生率未知

claims.claim: 胸部突然出现的、持续不缓解的疼痛或不适是立即呼叫急救的指征（英国 NHS 患者指引；在中国急救电话为 120）。
claims.supportQuote: you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 急救指征的权威来源，处置原则本地化到中国 120
claims.uncertainty: 英国来源，急救电话已本地化为中国 120，未改变来源命题

claims.claim: 已发表随机对照试验中速效救心丸的连续给药时长为 4 周至 24 周，试验通用剂量为每次 5 丸、每日三次。
claims.applicability: 回答已发表证据支持的最长连续给药时长
claims.uncertainty: 24 周来自方案全文与一篇中文 RCT 摘要，均非说明书明示疗程；更长疗程的中文研究可能因数据库不可访问而漏检

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Efficacy and safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pill in the treatment of stable angina (Qi stagnation and blood stasis syndrome): study protocol of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multi-center clinical trial
supportingSources.supportQuote: Eligible participants will receive either SJP or placebo (five pills administered orally, three times daily) in addition to conventional treatment for 24 weeks.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
supportingSources.supportQuote: orally administer the study medication sublingually after meals, three times a day, taking 5 capsules each time (total of 15 capsules per day), continuously for 4 weeks

claims.claim: 按试验剂量 5 丸、每日 3 次连续用药，24 周疗程共消耗约 2520 丸。
claims.assumptions: 按试验剂量连续用药、无遗漏；每次 5 丸、每日 3 次。
claims.sensitivity: 若按说明书转载口径 4～6 丸/次，日消耗 12～18 丸，24 周消耗 2016～3024 丸；总量随每次用量在 12～18 丸/日区间线性变动。
claims.applicability: 消耗周期推算，仅用于说明连续用药所需包装量
claims.uncertainty: 推算不是实测；不含急性发作追加剂量与个体发作频次

claims.claim: 单个大规格包装（在售口径 50 丸×3 瓶=150 丸、60 丸×2 瓶=120 丸）按试验剂量 15 丸/日仅可供连续用药约 8～10 日。
claims.method: 按试验剂量 15 丸/日计算：150 丸 ÷ 15 丸/日 = 10 日；120 丸 ÷ 15 丸/日 = 8 日。
claims.assumptions: 包装规格取在售常见规格（商业药品信息页转载口径，非本轮核验的注册包装规格）；每日 15 丸连续用药。
claims.sensitivity: 包装丸数与每日丸数的变化使天数等比例变动；若仅急性发作备用（每次 10～15 丸、按个体发作频次），消耗周期由发作频次决定，不适用此推算，可短至数周亦可超过效期。
claims.applicability: 说明连续用药与大规格包装的数量关系
claims.uncertainty: 包装规格未经注册记录核验，且不含效期这一未核验参数

claims.claim: 按《中华人民共和国药典》要求，速效救心丸每丸含川芎以阿魏酸计不少于 15.0 μg、含冰片以冰片计 2.9～4.4 mg。
claims.sourceTitle: Efficacy and Safety of Suxiao Jiuxin Pills in the Treatment of Chronic Coronary Syndrome with Intolerance to Adverse Effects of Long-acting Nitrates: A Multicenter, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study
claims.supportQuote: each pill of SJPs is required to contain a minimum of 15.0 μg of Ligusticum chuanxiong, expressed in terms of ferulic acid … and 2.9 to 4.4 mg of Borneolum syntheticum, expressed in terms of Borneol
claims.applicability: 国家药品标准含量要求，用于核对规格表述
claims.uncertainty: 含量标准经同行评议全文转述，药典原文未直接核验
